features.name: Punching dagger with an H-shaped frame and the crossbar used as the hand grip.
Wide-based triangular blade sits above the H-shaped handle frame.

Actual Arsenal printed14/PDF16 labeled KATAR and generated detail compared. Wide-based triangular blade with intact apex and broad blade facets, two long frame rails, transverse handhold and actual open frame spaces agree. Near-profile interpretation preserves source H-frame rather than a normal handled dagger or scissor blade. Dark frame/brushed blade and fine rivet/wrap details are appearance choices, not unique canonical colors. Full object fits the1254 square; RGB white background still needs foreground conditioning. Actual matching clay has completely smooth grip/fittings with fine cuts, wrap, fasteners and texture filled; broad blade facets and major boundaries retained. Assigned sole reviewer inspected native/final independent masks, teal views and paired overlay. Genuine frame/guard/ring openings and thin structures preserved; specular metal highlights remain foreground. No clipped tip, missing rail/bar, detached foreground, broad fringe or shadow. Raw RGB unchanged; common crop/scale/offset only. 2048 output is resampled from1254 square, not native2K. Reference approval only.
